trick: Pilot E1: which current model sits in the middle?
source_note: Not a trick (PROTOCOL change log, 19 Oct, E1). Plain Claude Code on t2 and the hard tasks, current Sonnet on one side and current Haiku on the other, to pick the Season 2 model (pass rate between 40% and 70%) and the task list (tasks between 30% and 70%). Model ids are confirmed with a one-line claude -p call before the run and written into runs/pilot-e1-models/models.txt.
